marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Consists of 3 episodes: The secret of success- Spring break and everyone is lounging around until Franklin encourages them to try something new. But setting goals are easier than achieving them. Will they have the perseverane to keep going? ; The winning goal- Maria is the new soccer coach, and EJ is not pleased with her emphasis on being good sports. This could ruin his entire season and take all the fun out of the game ; Road rage- Johnny's perfect summer plan is to join the Auto Stunt Thrill Team! When his friends show up to try-outs to cheer him on, he gets distracted, races off the track at high speed and into a life changing lesson
